outputs.explanation: Panel A shows representative bright-field and fluorescence photographs of lungs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B is a bar chart of mean ICG fluorescence intensity with error bars (mean ± SD), and individual mouse data points (blue for No Cre, red for Adeno Cre) are overlaid on the bars.

Panel C combines micrographs (H&E, ICG fluorescence, Tmprss11b RNAscope) with spatial transcriptomics heatmap plots (Cd68, Spp1 expression overlaid on tissue). Heatmaps are exempt from the individual data point requirement.

Panel D shows GSEA enrichment score line plots. Line plots are exempt from the individual data point requirement since overlaying points would be unreadable and is not the standard convention for this plot type.

Panel E is a bar chart of log2 fold-change values per gene derived from differential gene expression analysis (Seurat FindMarkers, Wilcoxon test), each bar representing a single computed statistic with an associated p value rather than a mean of independent replicate measurements. This is not the type of replicate-averaged bar chart the individual-data-points check targets.
Panel F shows representative fluorescence and IHC images (photographs/micrographs), not a plot summarizing averaged quantitative data.
